description: Get active domestic SIGMETs, international SIGMETs (including oceanic products), and Center Weather Advisories from the NWS Aviation Weather Center. Filter by advisory_type, hazard, or ordered bbox. Returns source coverage, decoded hazards/altitudes/movement, multipart geometry, and original bulletins; missing facts stay null. Independent source failures retain healthy results with partial coverage. AIRMET requests are rejected; this tool does not retrieve AIRMETs. Omit limit to return every available match; an explicit limit sorts results and discloses withheld matches.

advisory_type.description: Product selection: sigmet is domestic SIGMETs, isigmet is international SIGMETs, cwa is Center Weather Advisories, and all reads all three independently. airmet is rejected with guidance to separate AIRMET products.

bbox.description: Ordered geographic bounding box. Matches each geometry part by its bounding envelope, not exact polygon intersection; date-line-crossing source geometry is unwrapped.

maxLat.description: Northern boundary latitude in decimal degrees.

maxLon.description: Eastern boundary longitude in decimal degrees.

minLat.description: Southern boundary latitude in decimal degrees.

minLon.description: Western boundary longitude in decimal degrees.

hazard.description: Upstream hazard filter. Domestic: CONVECTIVE, TURBULENCE, ICING, IFR. International: TS, TURBULENCE, ICING, MTW (mountain wave), DS (duststorm), SS (sandstorm), TC (tropical cyclone), VA (volcanic ash). CWA: TS, TURBULENCE, ICING, IFR, PCPN (precipitation), UNK (unknown). Incompatible sources are not_applicable; wholly incompatible selections are rejected. MTN OBSCN, SURFACE WIND and LLWS are not served and are rejected. A hazard-scoped zero says nothing about other hazards.

limit.description: Optional maximum matches to return, without a default or automatic cap. Sorts by source, issuer, series and validity; omit or raise it to retrieve withheld matches.

name: aviation_get_advisories

advisories.description: Active advisories matching the filter criteria. May be empty during fair weather periods.

items.description: An active advisory, with source omissions preserved as null.

advisory_type.description: Product type: SIGMET, ISIGMET or CWA.

altitude_high_ft.description: Upper altitude bound in feet MSL, or null if not specified.

altitude_low_ft.description: Lower altitude bound in feet MSL, or null if not specified.

fir_id.description: Flight information region identifier, or null when omitted.

fir_name.description: Flight information region name, or null when omitted.

kind.description: Source-native geometry kind (AREA, AREAS, LINE), or null when omitted.

parts.description: Separate rings or lines, never flattened into connecting edges.

items.description: One intact source ring or line.
A polygon vertex as a lat/lon coordinate pair.

geometry.description: Decoded source geometry, or null when no complete coordinates can be decoded.

hazard.description: Source-native hazard type, or null when omitted.

issued_by.description: Issuing office ICAO ID or CWSU code; null when omitted.

direction_deg.description: Domestic source movement direction in degrees true (FROM semantics); null when omitted or international.

direction_text.description: International source-native direction text, without converting to domestic FROM-angle semantics; null when omitted.

speed_kt.description: Decoded movement speed in knots, or null when omitted.

movement.description: System movement vector, or null if not available.

items.description: A polygon vertex as a lat/lon coordinate pair.

polygon.description: Single-area compatibility boundary; null for multipart, line or missing geometry.

qualifier.description: Source-native hazard qualifier, or null when omitted.

raw_text.description: Original bulletin text, preserving line breaks and blank lines; null when omitted.

series_id.description: Advisory series identifier, or null when omitted.

severity.description: Severity integer for convective SIGMETs (higher = more intense). Null when the advisory stated none.

valid_from.description: Advisory validity start time in ISO 8601 format (UTC), or null when omitted.

valid_to.description: Advisory validity end time in ISO 8601 format (UTC), or null when omitted.

coverage.description: Coverage of selected sources, independent of bbox and limit.

drawn.description: Decoded rows after product/hazard selection, before bbox; null for failed or not_applicable sources.

message.description: Source failure, skipped-row or applicability explanation.

status.description: Readable response, unavailable response or unsupported source/hazard pair.

drawn.description: With bbox: decoded rows after product/hazard, before geographic filtering; successful sources only.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_bbox`: The bounding box is inverted — minLat > maxLat or minLon > maxLon. `airmet_not_served`: advisory_type "airmet" was requested, or an unsupported AIRMET-family hazard (MTN OBSCN, SURFACE WIND, LLWS). `hazard_not_supported`: No selected source supports the hazard. `advisory_sources_failed`: Every applicable source failed or was unreadable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matched.description: With bbox: rows intersecting any geometry part, before limit.

notice.description: Coverage-scoped empty, bbox-removal or explicit-limit explanation and recovery. Failed sources never establish zero coverage.

partial.description: True when a source failed or unreadable rows were skipped; no complete-coverage claim is possible.

returned.description: With bbox or explicit limit: rows returned after limit.

total.description: With explicit limit: all available matches before limiting.

truncated.description: With explicit limit: whether matches were withheld. Omit or raise limit to retrieve them.

unlocated.description: With bbox: drawn rows lacking decoded geometry; not known to be outside the box.

title: Get Active Aviation Advisories
